# Local OCR assets

Pinned npm packages: tesseract.js 6.0.1, tesseract.js-core and English data as
specified in manifest.json. Files copied from the official npm distributions;
SHA-256 and sizes are recorded in the manifest. Apache-2.0 code license copies
and bundle attributions are included; the English data package declares MIT.

Sources: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js and
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata.
Only the LSTM core and English best-int data variant are included.
Runtime URLs are same-origin; user photos are not uploaded.
